notes: TRAP CASE #1, CONFIRMED AS A TRAP. Esade publishes a long ladder of application deadlines running from autumn through to the following summer, which reads at a glance like several intakes; it is not. The programme's own Program Details block names exactly one edition ('Next edition September 2027') and the Academics page names exactly one start ('Official Program Start: 14th September 2026'), preceded by July-September pre-programme work. The multi-round calendar is an application-round ladder against a single September cohort. CAVEAT ON PROVENANCE: the specific count of NINE rounds (Round 1 ~1 October, Round 9 ~1 July) came back only through the search index and aggregator pages, and the deadlines page itself renders its table in JavaScript that curl does not retrieve — so the ROUND COUNT is NOT primary-verified here. The single-September-start finding IS primary-verified and is the load-bearing part.

evidence_verbatim: Maestría Oficial en Data Science & Business Analytics · Online con clases en directo · Próxima convocatoria: Octubre 2026 · 60 Créditos
notes: Discovered via an aggregator (tumaster.com) claiming a MARCH start for IMMUNE's Data Science & Business Analytics master. The primary site contradicts it: every single programme shows 'Próxima convocatoria: Octubre 2026'. The March figure is a stale 2025 edition date. Two cautions recorded for the sweep: (1) IMMUNE markets a programme as 'Oficial' when the officiality is Panamanian (UMECIT), which is exactly the kind of wording that could be mistaken for a máster universitario; (2) IMMUNE's other partner is 'Institute Nebrija', not Universidad Nebrija's official register.
